{{Otheruses|Ordnance and Supply}}
'''The Department of Naval Ordnance and Supply''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] organization. Among other responsibilities, it oversaw the acquisition and supply of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to the Alliance.
